title: Herbed Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful Filipino-inspired dish made with marinated chicken breasts, herbs, and vegetables grilled to perfection.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together herbed seasoning, vegetable oil, lime juice, garlic, and onion.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Thread the mushrooms and bell pepper onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
8. Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes.
9. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
